title: FBI 'image cheapening' of Jean Seberg

tellings.quote: the context in which image cheapening is has been used or famously against a woman who was a leading actress in hollywood named jean seberg and the fbi is how we learned about image cheapening planted a story with a woman named joyce haber in the los angeles times that the baby that she was carrying was in fact not her french husbands but was in fact the baby of a black panther

plain: Around 1970 the FBI, the US federal police, is said to have planted a false story in the Los Angeles Times, through the gossip columnist Joyce Haber, claiming that the Hollywood actress Jean Seberg's unborn baby was not her French husband's but a Black Panther activist's. A mathematician named Eric Weinstein tells this as the famous case of what the FBI called image cheapening, a way of ruining someone's reputation. He brings it up to show that agencies have used such tactics to discredit people.
